line_mapping: line_aa340fb is the line Necessist reported; line_fda9bed is the same unchanged line at fda9bed (difflib match of the test file), null when that line changed or the file was removed.

classes.real-test-gap: A removal showing a behaviour the tests should pin and do not (none recorded in this pass).
classes.equivalent-or-harmless: The statement is redundant for what the test pins; reason says which code or test structure makes it so.
classes.noise: The statement is itself a check, a log, or a condition an independence test sets on purpose.

not_triaged.reason: Statements that change state (setup calls, assignments, pranks, warps, mocks, snapshots, helpers that act) need a reading of each test; not done in this pass beyond the groups above. Counts per test file:

entries.reason: The removed statement is a call to a test helper that only checks (its body is assertions and/or a vm.prank + vm.expectRevert/expectEmit/expectCall + the checked call, with no warp, roll, deal, store or startPrank). Removing a check can never make a test fail; Necessist skips Foundry's own assert*/vm.expect* statements but not helpers that wrap them. Helper bodies were resolved in the same test file at aa340fb, else across test/.

entries.reason: test_TEST_027_receiverRuleRefusesEveryClass fills an array of receivers that must all be refused and checks each; removing one assignment leaves that element address(0), which is itself in the refused set, so the loop still passes. The original test does check every listed receiver; Necessist's removal only replaces one refused value by another.

Independence tests: the test pins that an action is NOT affected by a hostile or stopped environment (a broken registry or RiskModule, a frozen wallet, a paused Hub, another Hub's pause, an approve-all RiskModule, a halted Spoke), and sets several such conditions at once. Removing one of them leaves the action in a less hostile environment, where it must pass too; the statement is what makes the test meaningful, but its removal cannot make a correct implementation fail. Selected by the setter (setBroken(true), setFrozen(.., true), a Paused/Frozen pause, setApproveAll(true), _setHalted(.., true), _setState) in a test whose name states the independence (Ignores, Still, Never, NoEffect, OtherHub, InEveryPauseState, WithBroken, ReadsNoRegistry, ...).
